verdict.rationale: Sentry's official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors and triage issues, optionally scoped to an organization or project. A public, versioned API with an OpenAPI schema exposes project issue listing and bulk mutation, so the pull-and-triage half of the story is clearly documented. The pack does not show Sentry itself filing triaged bugs into an external tracker; its coding-agent integrations route root-cause analysis to agents for PRs, which is a different capability. Missing for 10: documented filing of issues into a tracker (Jira/GitHub Issues/Linear) via API or MCP, explicit confirmation that stack traces are returned through MCP/API, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
